item.title: Haim Sisters Reveal Their Go-To Makeup Essentials: Here’s How to Shop The Trio’s Favorites Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest beauty trends and must-haves. Today, we're talking about the rock band Haim and their favorite makeup products from ILIA, a clean beauty brand that's all about making your skin better. Let's get started!
[Short music transition]
Host: Haim, consisting of Este, Alana, and Danielle, recently starred in ILIA's campaign video "Almost Ready", where they spilled the beans on their favorite products. One of the standout products featured in the video is ILIA's Super Serum Skin Tint SPF 40, which retails for $48 on the brand's website.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: This serum tint is perfect for summer, as it's lightweight and provides demi-coverage. It's also formulated with SPF 40, protecting your skin from sun damage while evening out your complexion. The texture is water-like, thanks to ingredients like Niacinamide and hyaluronic acid, which smooth and hydrate the skin.
[Short music transition]
Host: The Haim sisters also shared their favorite products from ILIA's extensive beauty line, including stick blushes, mascara, and more. Este's top picks include the ILIA Multi-Stick Blush in Lady Bird, a taupey hue that provides a sheer finish, and the ILIA Limitless Lash Mascara in Rich Brown, which gives a natural look without being too harsh.
[Soft music continues]
Host: These products embody the "clean girl" aesthetic, which is all about subtly accentuating features without drastically changing your face. The ILIA Multi-Stick Blush is also multi-use and can be used as a lip product, making it a great addition to your everyday makeup routine.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's it for today's episode. If you're looking for natural, breathable makeup products that align with the "clean girl" aesthetic, be sure to check out ILIA's products, including the Super Serum Skin Tint SPF 40 and Este's favorite picks. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
